purpose: Detect performance/resource degradation before it becomes a human-observable field defect.

collection.production_mode: cheap rolling counters only; no per-frame JSON/logging/allocation
collection.diagnostic_mode: deeper tracing explicitly enabled only for bounded diagnosis

rules: Metrics must be available without serial console access.
Normal collection must not allocate/log once per rendered frame.
Every performance sample must identify kernel/variant.
Frame-time percentiles are authoritative over average FPS for smoothness regressions.
Heap health includes free heap, minimum free heap, and largest free block; free heap alone is insufficient.
Install health and runtime qualification remain separate gates.
